# LUCAS

Land Use and Cover Survey (LUCAS) library from European soils (23-28 countries)

## Overview

- **Sample size:** 20,000+
- **Version:** 2009, 2012, 2015
- **Spectral range:** vnir
- **Extent:** continental

## Map

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/soilspectroscopy/ossl-imports/main/dataset/LUCAS/README_files/figure-gfm/map-1.png)

## Database access

[Open dataset files](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/LUCAS/)

## Soil laboratory information

- **n properties available:** 13
- **n properties standardized:** 13
- **n properties harmonized:** pending
- **properties themes:** physical, chemical, carbon & nutrients, metal elements

## Soil site information

- **coordinates precision:** precise, country
- **sampling depth:** top
- **geography:** soil taxonomy, elevation, landuse
